audio_observation: Speaker clearly says a complete sentence.
raw_spoken_form: Tôi sẽ gửi báo cáo vào chiều nay.
expected_transcription: Tôi sẽ gửi báo cáo vào chiều nay.
annotation_rule: Transcribe all clearly spoken words.

audio_observation: Speaker hesitates before continuing with the sentence.
raw_spoken_form: Ừm tôi nghĩ chúng ta nên bắt đầu.
expected_transcription: [ừm] tôi nghĩ chúng ta nên bắt đầu.
annotation_rule: Filler words use square brackets.

audio_observation: Speaker uses a short acknowledgment filler.
raw_spoken_form: Ừ tôi hiểu rồi.
expected_transcription: [ừ] tôi hiểu rồi.
annotation_rule: Use the approved filler spelling.

audio_observation: Speaker makes a noticeable pause outside normal punctuation.
raw_spoken_form: Tôi nghĩ rằng chúng ta nên đi pause chúng ta nên đi xem phim.
expected_transcription: Tôi nghĩ rằng chúng ta nên đi <pause> chúng ta nên đi xem phim.
annotation_rule: Use <pause> for a meaningful pause outside normal punctuation.

audio_observation: Speaker laughs while continuing to speak.
raw_spoken_form: Chuyện đó buồn cười quá.
expected_transcription: <laugh> Chuyện đó buồn cười quá.
annotation_rule: Non-verbal laughter is represented with <laugh>.

audio_observation: Speaker coughs briefly during speech.
raw_spoken_form: Tôi muốn nói <cough> rằng chúng ta nên đi.
expected_transcription: Tôi muốn nói <cough> rằng chúng ta nên đi.
annotation_rule: Represent audible coughing with a non-verbal tag.

audio_observation: One word is understandable but uncertain.
raw_spoken_form: Bạn gặp vấn đề với cân bằng.
expected_transcription: Bạn gặp vấn đề với ((cân bằng)).
annotation_rule: Use double parentheses for a reasonable but uncertain interpretation.

audio_observation: A short portion is completely muffled.
raw_spoken_form: Bạn cần gửi <inaudible> trước chiều mai.
expected_transcription: Bạn cần gửi <inaudible> trước chiều mai.
annotation_rule: Use <inaudible> when the word cannot be confidently determined.

audio_observation: Speaker inserts a clearly recognizable foreign-language word.
raw_spoken_form: Tôi cần hoàn thành việc này trước mañana.
expected_transcription: Tôi cần hoàn thành việc này trước {mañana}.
annotation_rule: Use curly brackets for a foreign-language word or phrase.

audio_observation: Speaker spells a name letter by letter.
raw_spoken_form: Tên tôi được đánh vần là T I R E L L Y.
expected_transcription: Tên tôi được đánh vần là T I R E L L Y.
annotation_rule: Spoken spelling is transcribed as separated capital letters.

audio_observation: Two speakers alternate clearly.
raw_spoken_form: Speaker 1 says Được rồi. Speaker 2 says Đồng ý.
expected_transcription: (Speaker 1) Được rồi. (Speaker 2) Đồng ý.
annotation_rule: Apply consistent speaker labels.

audio_observation: Two speakers overlap briefly and one short section cannot be understood.
raw_spoken_form: Speaker 1 says a sentence while Speaker 2 overlaps for a short section.
expected_transcription: (Speaker 1) Tôi nghĩ chúng ta nên <inaudible> rồi tiếp tục.
annotation_rule: Use <inaudible> for a limited unintelligible overlap and transcribe the rest.

audio_observation: Speaker says a number in words.
raw_spoken_form: Tôi có bốn mươi hai khách.
expected_transcription: Tôi có 42 khách.
annotation_rule: Normalize numerical expressions into written form.

audio_observation: Speaker says a year using spoken words.
raw_spoken_form: Năm hai nghìn mười.
annotation_rule: Normalize the spoken year into written form.

audio_observation: Speaker states a monetary amount in words.
raw_spoken_form: Giá là năm trăm đô-la.
expected_transcription: Giá là $500.
annotation_rule: Normalize monetary expressions into the specified written form.

audio_observation: Speaker states a percentage in words.
raw_spoken_form: Giảm hai mươi lăm phần trăm.
expected_transcription: Giảm 25%.
annotation_rule: Normalize percentage expressions.

audio_observation: Speaker begins a word, stops, then restarts.
raw_spoken_form: Cậu ta tên là P Ph Phương.
expected_transcription: Cậu ta tên là P-Ph-Phương.
annotation_rule: Use a trailing hyphen to represent incomplete word fragments.

audio_observation: Speaker repeats complete words rather than producing fragments.
raw_spoken_form: Nhớ mang theo ô ô ô.
expected_transcription: Nhớ mang theo ô ô ô!
annotation_rule: Complete repeated words do not receive fragment hyphens.

audio_observation: Audio ends abruptly during an unfinished thought.
raw_spoken_form: Tôi rất mong được tham dự
expected_transcription: Tôi rất mong được tham dự—
annotation_rule: Use an em dash for an abruptly cut-off ending.

audio_observation: Speaker uses a recognizable regional form.
raw_spoken_form: Hổng dám đâu.
expected_transcription: Hổng dám đâu.
annotation_rule: Preserve dialectal pronunciation instead of silently correcting it.

audio_observation: Speaker uses profanity that is audible and understandable.
raw_spoken_form: Từ đó thật sự rất tệ.
expected_transcription: Từ đó thật sự rất tệ.
annotation_rule: Transcribe inappropriate language faithfully when understandable.

audio_observation: There is audible environmental noise but speech remains clear.
raw_spoken_form: Cậu cứ gửi tài liệu cho tôi.
expected_transcription: Cậu cứ gửi tài liệu cho tôi. <noise>
annotation_rule: Annotate meaningful audible environmental noise when it does not prevent comprehension.

audio_observation: Persistent loud static overlaps speech and makes the primary speaker impossible to understand.
raw_spoken_form: Primary speech cannot be reliably determined.
annotation_rule: Reject when noise prevents comprehension of the primary speaker.

audio_observation: Two speakers overlap throughout a critical section and the primary speaker cannot be understood.
raw_spoken_form: Primary speech cannot be reliably separated.
annotation_rule: Reject when overlapping speakers prevent understanding of the primary speaker.
